info.title: DAD donor mobile API
info.description:
The DAD (Dynamic Aid Delivery) donor API, serving the web app, the donor iOS/Android app, and the staff back office.

## Clients and authentication
- **Browsers** authenticate with HttpOnly cookies. Every mutation must carry the exact configured `Origin`; this is the CSRF defense. The API sends no CORS headers.
- **The donor app** sends `X-DAD-Client: native` on every request, never sends `Origin` or cookies, and authenticates with `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. A request with Origin or cookies is a browser request whatever else it carries. Sign in by calling POST /donor/login, opening the emailed `/account/claim#token=…` link in the app, and sending the fragment's token to POST /donor/claim as a native request, which returns a 15-minute access token and a rotating refresh token. Exchange the refresh token at POST /donor/refresh when the access token expires or a request answers 401; send one refresh at a time and keep only the newest tokens. Routes that admit the app list `native` in `x-clients`, and POST /donor/refresh and the push-device routes admit nothing else; giving, referral capture, partner applications, and every staff route are web-only.
- **Partner portal** users are separate from donors (P-5). They sign in by calling POST /donor/partner/sign-in and opening the emailed `/partner/accept#token=…` link, whose token POST /donor/partner/accept-invite exchanges for a 12-hour session: an HttpOnly cookie for a browser, or a bearer token for a native request, sent like the donor app's.
- Staff routes are browser-only and never accept bearer tokens. The back office runs on its own host (`DONOR_STAFF_ORIGIN`): staff mutations require that exact `Origin`, and donor and public mutations require the public one, so neither site can act on the other.

## Rate limits
Mutations are rate limited per client address and class (`x-rate-limit`): auth 10/min, visitor 60/min, account 30/min, staff 60/min, with bursts up to the same size. Exceeding one answers 429 with `Retry-After`. Reads are not rate limited by the API.

## Conventions
- Errors are always `application/json` `{"detail": "…"}` with the status below; the detail is safe to display. A 503 for a feature the deployment has not configured adds a stable `code` and should not be retried. Unknown routes and malformed record IDs answer 404, wrong methods 405 with `Allow`.
- Request bodies are one JSON object with exactly the documented fields (unknown fields, trailing data, NUL characters, and `null` for a defaulted field are 422), at most 256 KiB unless stated (larger is 413).
- Money is integer USD cents in fields ending `_minor`; the API shows the same numbers on every client.
- Timestamps are RFC 3339 strings, UTC, possibly with fractional seconds (`2026-10-06T14:03:00Z`, `…+00:00` in gift records). Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- Lists page by `offset`, 50 rows per page; a response's `next_offset` (or `next_<list>_offset`) is the next page's offset, or null on the last page.
- Commands that reach the payment processor or deliver email require an `Idempotency-Key`; retry with the same key after a timeout or 503.
- Every response is `Cache-Control: no-store` except published content.

servers.description: The API host, which the donor app calls directly.

commit.description: The running build's VCS revision, or "unknown".

post.description: Ingests a batch of §9 analytics events from any platform into the shared append-only stream. Authenticated-or-anonymous: a valid donor session attributes the events, otherwise they are recorded anonymously (events before sign-in are expected). The platform source is the native client's `X-DAD-Platform` header, or WEB for a browser. The whole batch is rejected (422) if any event has an unknown name or an invalid property payload. Batch size is capped at 100.

occurred_at.description: Client event time (RFC 3339). Rejected if missing or implausibly in the future.

properties.description: Typed payload for the events that carry one: attribution_captured requires {source: link|IRL|company}, invite_shared requires {channel}, push_opened requires {type}. All other events take no properties.

post.description: 503 `EMAIL_UNCONFIGURED` when the deployment has no email. Never reveals whether the address exists. The link (`/account/claim#token=…`) is single-use and expires after 15 minutes; the app should handle it as a universal/app link and call POST /donor/claim.

next.description: Page the emailed link returns to after sign-in. Optional; null or any other value is 422.

202.description: Accepted, whether or not the address has an account.

post.summary: Exchange an emailed sign-in proof for a session
post.description: A browser request receives an HttpOnly cookie and `{"claimed":true}`. A native request (`X-DAD-Client: native`, no Origin, no cookies) receives NativeSession, a new access and refresh token, and no cookie; it may describe its device so the donor can recognize the session later. Any session presented with the request (cookie or bearer) is revoked. 401 means the link is invalid, used, or expired.

token.description: Proof from the emailed link fragment.

device_name.description: Native requests only, optional: the device's user-visible name, shown to the donor in their session list. Control and formatting characters are removed. Ignored for browser requests.

platform.description: Native requests only, optional. Ignored for browser requests.

oneOf.description: Browser request: the session is set only as the `dad_donor_session` cookie.

post.summary: Exchange the app's refresh token for new tokens
post.description: Native requests only; a browser request is 403 even from the public origin. Returns a new access token and a new refresh token, and the previous access token stops working at once. Each refresh token works once. Presenting one the session has already exchanged revokes the whole session (every token issued since that sign-in) and records a security event, because the app or someone who copied the token is using a stale one. The one exception covers a lost response: the refresh token exchanged most recently is accepted again for one minute after that exchange, and answered with yet another pair that supersedes the first. Concurrent refreshes with one token are therefore answered in turn, and only the tokens answered last keep working, so send one refresh at a time and keep only the newest tokens. 401 means the session has ended: sign in again by email.
Needs only the emailed proof. Completion revokes every session, including the app's, and removes every passkey; it never issues a session, so sign in again afterwards.

stage.description: NEW: the current address is verified and a link went to the new address. COMPLETED: the email changed and every session was revoked.

post.description: Succeeds even when the session is already invalid (no 401), so a client can always discard its credential. Ends the whole session: for the app, its refresh token stops working too. Browser responses expire the cookie.
Ends every session of the donor, this one included. Passkeys are kept; remove them with POST /donor/me/passkeys/{passkey_id}/delete.

get.summary: Where the donor is signed in

post.description: Ends one of the donor's other sessions at once: its cookie, access token, and refresh token stop working immediately. A session that has already ended succeeds again. 404 when the ID is not one of the donor's sessions. 409 for the session making the request; use POST /donor/logout for that.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: A malformed ID is 404, like an unknown one.

200.description: The donor's sessions after the request.

post.description: Ends every session of the donor except the one making the request, at once.

200.description: The donor's sessions after the request.

post.description: Sends a confirmation to the current address first, then to the new one. 503 `EMAIL_UNCONFIGURED` when the deployment has no email.

Replaces the donor's self-service identity fields. `timezone` is derived from `zip` (US ZIP to IANA zone) and is never accepted from the client; `account_role` is immutable and cannot be set here. A field sent empty clears its stored value; a blank `zip` clears the derived `timezone` with it. 422 for an invalid ZIP, phone, or city.

zip.description: US ZIP (`12345` or `12345-6789`). Empty clears the ZIP and derived timezone.

phone.description: E.164 phone, e.g. `+14155550123`. Empty clears it.

post.description: Erases the donor's personal data and signs them out everywhere. Personal fields and personal records (passkeys, social sign-in links, notification preferences, sessions and push registrations) are removed; the gift and billing ledger is retained for legal and tax records and carries no personal data. The deletion is irreversible. A browser's session cookie is cleared in the response. Refused with 409 while a monthly gift is still set to renew, or a checkout is still open, so a deleted account is never charged.

Set-Cookie.description: Browser requests only: clears the session cookie.

post.description: Saves the donor's notification, rankings, network and volunteer choices. The required fields are always replaced; an optional field left out keeps its saved value. 409 when `version` is stale: re-read the profile and retry.

post.summary: Register this installation for app notifications
post.description: Native requests only. Records the push token of the app installation behind the calling session, replacing any token the session held. Register at every launch, since platforms rotate tokens. A token another session holds, the donor's or anyone's, moves to this session: it names one installation. The token is removed when the session is signed out, revoked, or ends, so sign-in again means registering again. Notifications carry generic text, a `category` (`REFERRAL_CONVERTED`, `STREAK_AT_RISK`, or `STREAK_MILESTONE`) and an app `path` to open, never names or amounts; fetch details through the API. 503 with `PUSH_UNCONFIGURED` when this deployment does not deliver to the platform. 401 for a browser session's credential.

token.description: For iOS, the APNs device token as hex (either case); for Android, the FCM registration token.

environment.description: iOS only: the APNs environment that issued the token (SANDBOX for development builds). Omit for Android.

200.description: The session's registration after the request.

post.summary: Stop app notifications to this installation
post.description: Native requests only. Removes the calling session's push token, if any; the session stays signed in.

200.description: The session's registration after the request.

get.description: Referrals that converted: when each referred donor's first gift was paid, and its channel, newest first, at most 20. A referral whose gifts were all refunded no longer appears, matching the dashboard's counts. Nothing identifies the referred donor. Pass the newest `converted_at` already shown as `since` to fetch only newer ones, for example after a notification.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only conversions strictly after this RFC 3339 time.

post.description: Replacing the code invalidates the old one for new visits.

replace_code.description: Defaults to false; null is invalid.

get.description: 409 until a public name is chosen.

get.description: Served from the subscription as last synced from Stripe by verified webhooks and recurring commands; it never calls Stripe. `observed_at` is when that sync happened.

Served from the subscription as last synced from Stripe by verified webhooks and recurring commands; it never calls Stripe. The matching POST checks current Stripe state and answers 409 when the offer no longer matches it.

post.summary: Change the monthly amount from the next renewal
post.description: Idempotent. Echo the values the matching GET returned; 409 when they no longer match current billing. 503 `PAYMENTS_UNCONFIGURED` when the deployment has no payment processor.

amount_minor.description: The monthly charge in integer USD cents: a whole number of dollars a day from $1 to $30, times 30 (3000 to 90000 in steps of 3000).

previous_minor.description: The amount the next renewal would charge, which may predate the daily rule.

get.description: Served from stored card update records; it never calls Stripe.

post.description: Idempotent. Echo the values the matching GET returned; 409 when they no longer match current billing. 503 `PAYMENTS_UNCONFIGURED` when the deployment has no payment processor.
No body. Open `url` in the system browser; poll GET /donor/me/payment-method afterwards.

Issues a usernameless WebAuthn challenge that any of the donor's passkeys for the public origin may answer, in a browser or, through its associated domain, the app. Pass `options` to `PublicKeyCredential.parseRequestOptionsFromJSON` and `navigator.credentials.get`, then answer within five minutes. No body.

Sends a one-time SMS code to a donor's phone. The response is always `{"sent": true}` and never reveals whether the phone has an account. 503 with this method unavailable when the deployment has no SMS provider configured.

200.description: A code was requested (sent only if the phone matches an account).

post.description: Verifies the SMS code and signs the donor in. 401 covers a wrong, expired, or over-tried code and a phone with no account alike, so none reveals whether an account exists. 503 when no SMS provider is configured.

device_name.description: Native requests only, optional. Ignored for browser requests.

platform.description: Native requests only, optional. Ignored for browser requests.

post.summary: Sign in with Apple or Google
post.description: Verifies a provider id_token and signs in the donor it belongs to. The identity is matched by a prior link, else by the token's verified email against an existing account (which records the link). 401 covers an unverifiable token and a verified identity with no matching account alike; account creation happens in the giving flow, not here. 503 when the provider is not configured.

id_token.description: The provider's id_token (JWT) from the native or web sign-in SDK.

device_name.description: Native requests only, optional. Ignored for browser requests.

platform.description: Native requests only, optional. Ignored for browser requests.

post.description: Verifies the assertion (challenge, origin, relying party, user verification, and signature) and signs the donor in, as a claim does. Each ceremony is answered once. 401 covers an unknown passkey, a disabled account, a signature counter that went backwards, and an unknown, expired, or used ceremony alike.

ceremony.description: The `ceremony` from the matching options response.

credential.description: The browser's `PublicKeyCredential` as JSON (`credential.toJSON()`), with base64url binary fields; at most 64 KiB.

device_name.description: Native requests only, optional: the device's user-visible name, shown to the donor in their session list. Control and formatting characters are removed. Ignored for browser requests.

platform.description: Native requests only, optional. Ignored for browser requests.

oneOf.description: Browser request: the session is set only as the `dad_donor_session` cookie.

post.description: Issues WebAuthn creation options requiring a discoverable, user-verifying passkey, excluding those the donor already holds. Pass `options` to `PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON` and `navigator.credentials.create`, then answer within five minutes. No body.

Verifies the attestation, stores the passkey, and emails the donor an essential notice naming it. 401 covers a rejected attestation, a passkey already registered to any account, a ceremony begun by another donor, and an unknown, expired, or used ceremony alike, as well as a missing session.

ceremony.description: The `ceremony` from the matching options response.

credential.description: The browser's `PublicKeyCredential` as JSON (`credential.toJSON()`), with base64url binary fields; at most 64 KiB.

name.description: Optional label to tell passkeys apart, such as the device or password manager. Plain text without control characters.

200.description: The donor's passkeys after the request.

post.description: The passkey stops signing in at once. Sessions it already started are not ended; see POST /donor/me/sessions/revoke-others. 404 when the ID is not one of the donor's passkeys.

parameters.description: A malformed ID is 404, like an unknown one.

parameters.description: A malformed ID is 404, like an unknown or draft one.

get.summary: The donor's initiative of the day
Upcoming events in and near the donor's city (E-2)

post.summary: Check in at an event by scanning its QR token (E-8)
post.description: Checks the signed-in donor in from the QR code shown at the venue (E-8). Accepted only between the event's start and end, and only for a donor holding a reserved seat, not a waitlist place; 422 otherwise. A second scan succeeds with `already_checked_in`.

get.summary: Invite-only events the donor can see (E-5)
A donor's view of one event, enforcing the E-5 gate

post.summary: Reserve a spot (or join the waitlist) at an event (E-4)
post.description: Refused with 409 once the event has started or been cancelled, or before booking opens to this donor: Team Captains may reserve from 48 hours before booking_opens_at, everyone else from it.

post.summary: Cancel a reservation; promotes the waitlist head (E-4/E-9)

get.description: All 24 badges in catalog order with the donor's earned state. Earned badges show in color; an unearned one shows greyed with its `rule` (B-1). Badges are earned when the donor's facts change and stay earned (B-2).

post.summary: Email a partner portal sign-in link
post.description: 503 `EMAIL_UNCONFIGURED` when the deployment has no email. Never reveals whether the address belongs to a partner user. Each enabled user of an approved partner with this email receives a single-use link that expires after 15 minutes; at most one a minute and five an hour are sent per user.

202.description: Accepted, whether or not the address belongs to a partner user.

post.summary: Exchange an emailed partner sign-in link for a session
post.description: The link (`/partner/accept#token=…`) comes from an approval, an invitation, or POST /donor/partner/sign-in. It is single-use: approval and invitation links expire after 7 days, requested links after 15 minutes. A browser receives an HttpOnly session cookie and `signed_in`; the app, sending a native request, receives the bearer `session` instead.

user_id.description: The calling partner user's own id, as listed by partnerUsers.

description.description: The organization's description, as its administrators wrote it (§7.2).

get.description: Every figure is published and verified; nothing is estimated. Employee enrollment is null while fewer than 5 employees are linked (EM-3), and its percentage also without a workforce size. `updated_at` is when any figure last changed, null before a published initiative. `role` is the caller's own (ADMIN or VIEWER).
Published co-initiatives, active first, each with every published verified headline metric in display order, its spend by category, and when its figures last changed.

post.description: Admin only. Emails the person a single-use invitation link that expires after 7 days. Re-inviting an existing user refreshes their role and re-enables them. Refused with 409 when the email already has a donor or staff login, or signs in to another partner organization (one email, one role).

get.description: The IRL version of the partner's company code (EM-1): a QR code of `/c/{company code}` on the public site, which saves the code before an employee gives. Any partner role. 404 before the partner has a code.

post.summary: Sign out of the partner portal
Link to an employer by company code

get.description: The signed-in donor's employer and team, and their company's team leaderboard (EM-5, teams with fewer than 5 members left out). An unlinked donor gets empty fields.

Totals for the partner's linked employees (P-13): giving net of refunds, this calendar year's match owed (`matched_minor`), average current streak in days, volunteer minutes from event check-ins, and the number of teams. While fewer than 5 employees are linked every figure is 0 and `suppressed` is true (EM-3); individuals are never returned.
The company team leaderboard (EM-5), ranked by combined active giving (annualized pledges of members whose gift is current). Teams with fewer than 5 members are left out.

post.description: Replaces the organization's name and description (§7.2). Partner administrators only; viewers get 403. Both are trimmed; the name must be 1 to 200 characters and the description at most 4000.

get.summary: Download an immutable retained export owned by this partner

post.summary: Upload or remove a partner logo (admin only)

data_url.description: Base64 PNG/JPEG, at most 256 KiB and 512 by 512 pixels. Empty explicitly removes the logo. Stored as PNG without metadata.

post.description: Shown on the partner dashboard and included in new PDF reports. Partner administrators only; viewers get 403.

get.description: Active initiatives first. Cacheable for a minute.

parameters.description: A draft or unknown slug is 404.

get.summary: Download an authorized event as an .ics calendar file, including invite-only events

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: A malformed, unknown, draft, cancelled, or unauthorized event is 404.

post.summary: Partner app: Register this installation for app notifications
post.description: Native requests only. Records the push token of the app installation behind the calling session, replacing any token the session held. Register at every launch, since platforms rotate tokens. A token another session holds, the donor's or anyone's, moves to this session: it names one installation. The token is removed when the session is signed out, revoked, or ends, so sign-in again means registering again. Notifications carry generic text, a `category` (`REFERRAL_CONVERTED`, `STREAK_AT_RISK`, or `STREAK_MILESTONE`) and an app `path` to open, never names or amounts; fetch details through the API. 503 with `PUSH_UNCONFIGURED` when this deployment does not deliver to the platform. 401 for a browser session's credential.

token.description: For iOS, the APNs device token as hex (either case); for Android, the FCM registration token.

environment.description: iOS only: the APNs environment that issued the token (SANDBOX for development builds). Omit for Android.

200.description: The session's registration after the request.

post.summary: Partner app: Stop app notifications to this installation
post.description: Native requests only. Removes the calling session's push token, if any; the session stays signed in.

200.description: The session's registration after the request.

get.summary: Read the status of the application named by a private receipt

200.description: Application status only; no contact information or staff notes.

post.description: Starts account creation by emailing a verification link; no session is issued here. Answers 200 `{"sent":true}` whether or not the address already has an account, so it never reveals which. 503 `EMAIL_UNCONFIGURED` when the deployment has no email. The link (`/account/claim#token=…`) is single-use and expires after 15 minutes; the app should handle it as a universal/app link and call POST /donor/claim, which takes the optional `device_name` and `platform` that label the resulting session.

200.description: Link emailed (or silently not, for an address that already has a donor profile).

post.description: Signs in with an email and password. 401 covers a wrong password, an unknown email, an unclaimed account and a disabled account alike, so none reveals whether an account exists. A browser request receives an HttpOnly cookie; a native request (`X-DAD-Client: native`, no Origin, no cookies) receives NativeSession and may describe its device so the donor can recognize the session later.

device_name.description: Native requests only, optional: the device's user-visible name, shown to the donor in their session list. Ignored for browser requests.

platform.description: Native requests only, optional. Ignored for browser requests.

post.description: Sets or changes the signed-in donor's password. `current_password` is required unless the session proved its password within the last 15 minutes; leave it empty when setting a first password right after signing in by email link. 401 means the session is missing, expired or revoked: sign in again. 422 with `code` `CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT` means the session is fine but `current_password` was missing or wrong: keep the donor signed in and let them retry (attempts are rate limited). Contract versions before 2.4 answered 401 with the same `detail` ("The email or password is incorrect"); a client that must still talk to such a server should treat that 401 on this route as a wrong current password when the access token is otherwise valid.

422.description: The body or password is invalid (12 to 72 bytes), or `code` is `CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT` for a missing or wrong `current_password`.

cookieAuth.name: dad_donor_session
cookieAuth.description: Web donor session: HttpOnly, Secure on HTTPS, SameSite=Lax, 30 days at most and not extended by use. Set by POST /donor/claim for browser requests. Mutations also require the exact configured `Origin`.

bearerAuth.description: Donor app access token, from POST /donor/claim or POST /donor/refresh sent as a native request. It lasts 15 minutes and stops working as soon as it is refreshed, or its session is signed out, revoked, or ends; every request checks the session, so revocation is immediate. Accepted only on native requests: `X-DAD-Client: native`, no `Origin` header, and no `Cookie` header. Any request carrying Origin or cookies is treated as a browser request, its Authorization header is ignored, and its mutations need the exact Origin. Refresh tokens are never accepted here, and access tokens are never accepted by POST /donor/refresh. Never accepted for staff routes.

staffCookieAuth.name: dad_staff_session
staffCookieAuth.description: Staff session: HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, host-only on the staff host, 8 hours at most. Named `__Host-dad_staff_session` when the staff origin is HTTPS. Set by a passkey sign-in or activation. Browser-only; mutations require the exact staff `Origin`. Permissions are checked server-side against current staff state on every request.

stripeSignature.name: Stripe-Signature
stripeSignature.description: Stripe webhook signature over the raw request body.

partnerCookieAuth.name: dad_partner_session
partnerCookieAuth.description: Partner portal session: HttpOnly, Secure on HTTPS, SameSite=Lax, 12 hours. Set by POST /donor/partner/accept-invite for browser requests. Mutations also require the exact configured `Origin`. Never a donor or staff session.

partnerBearerAuth.description: Partner app session token, from POST /donor/partner/accept-invite sent as a native request. It lasts 12 hours. Accepted only on native requests (`X-DAD-Client: native`, no `Origin`, no `Cookie`), like bearerAuth. Never accepted for donor or staff routes.

applicationCookieAuth.name: dad_application_receipt
applicationCookieAuth.description: A 30-day receipt scoped only to the submitted application status; it does not authenticate a partner user.

applicationBearerAuth.description: The 32-byte base64url application receipt supplied at submission. Native requests only.

Forbidden.description: Browser requests: Origin is not the configured site origin, or, on staff routes, Sec-Fetch-Site is present and neither same-origin nor none. App requests: the route does not admit the app, or the request also carried Origin or cookies. Any browser request to a route that admits only the app. Some routes also use 403 for a permission or account restriction.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the route's limit (256 KiB for JSON unless stated).

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Send `Content-Type: application/json` (or an `application/*+json` type), or omit it.

Unprocessable.description: The body is not one JSON object of exactly the documented fields, a field or parameter is invalid (including any string containing NUL), or the Idempotency-Key is missing or not a version 4 UUID.

TooManyRequests.description: The client address exhausted this route's rate-limit class. Wait `Retry-After` seconds.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds until a request would be admitted.

Unavailable.description: Without `code`: the dependency behind this route failed or is not connected; retry later, reusing the Idempotency-Key for commands. With `code`: the feature is not configured in this deployment; do not retry.

Unauthorized.description: No valid session: missing, malformed, expired, or revoked. Sign in again.

Conflict.description: The record changed or conflicts with this request. Refresh before retrying; reusing an Idempotency-Key with different content also conflicts.

NotFound.description: No such record for this session, or no such route. A malformed record ID or referral code is also 404.

oneOf.description: Browser request: the session is set only as the `dad_donor_session` cookie.

Problem.description: Every non-2xx response, including unmatched routes (404) and methods (405).

detail.description: Human-readable explanation, safe to show to the user. Never contains credentials, donor data, or internal error text.

code.description: Present on a 503 for a feature this deployment has deliberately not configured (not transient: do not retry; show the feature as unavailable), and on the 422 of POST /donor/me/password when `current_password` is missing or wrong.

errors.description: Present only on a 422 from POST /donor/staff/founding-claims: every problem found, up to 100.

sheet.description: The spreadsheet the problem is in, or empty for a request field named by `column`.

row.description: Spreadsheet row, counting the header as row 1; 0 for the whole sheet.

NativeSession.description: The donor app's tokens, returned by POST /donor/claim and POST /donor/refresh to native requests only. Browsers never receive tokens in a body: their session is solely an HttpOnly cookie. Store both tokens in the platform keychain/keystore and replace both on every refresh.

access_token.description: Opaque. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` together with `X-DAD-Client: native`.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires: 900, or less when the session itself ends sooner.

refresh_token.description: Opaque and single-use: send it to POST /donor/refresh for the next pair. Never send it as a bearer token.

refresh_expires_in.description: Seconds until the session ends unless refreshed: 60 days after the latest refresh, and never more than a year after sign-in, when the donor signs in again by email.

sessions.description: Sessions that can still be used, including app sessions whose access token has expired but can be refreshed: the current session first, then by latest use, at most 50.

DeviceSession.description: One place the donor is signed in: a web browser (one per cookie) or an installation of the app.

id.description: Opaque session ID for POST /donor/me/sessions/{session_id}/revoke. It reveals nothing about any token.

platform.description: As reported by the app at sign-in; always null for browsers.

label.description: A name the donor can recognize, safe to display as plain text: the device name the app reported, otherwise “iOS device”, “Android device”, or “Mobile device”; every browser is “Web browser”.

last_used_at.description: The latest recorded use, recorded at most every five minutes and on every refresh, so it may trail the true last use by that much.

current.description: Whether this is the session making the request.

DonorDashboard.description: A null `referrals` or `streak` means the figure is not currently known; never show it as zero.

rank.description: The donor's own ranking (S-4), or null when unranked or opted out.

rankings_opted_out.description: True when the donor opted out of rankings. A null `rank` with this false means opted in but not yet ranked.

network.description: The donor's active-network headline (I-2), or null when they have no active referrals.

irl_minor.description: Collected dollars attributed to in-person referrals, after successful refunds, in cents.

link_minor.description: Collected dollars attributed to link referrals, after successful refunds, in cents.

at_risk.description: A renewal failed and is inside its 7-day grace period.

ladder.description: Day-based streak card (PRD S-2/S-3); absent when there is no streak.

NetworkCard.description: Dashboard headline for the donor's referral network (I-2).

active_count.description: Number of still-active donors the donor brought in.

annualized_minor.description: Combined annualized giving of those active donors (monthly pledge x 12), in minor units.

ImpactSummary.description: The donor's own impact totals (I-1, I-3).

given_minor.description: Total given since joining, net of refunds; null while it is being recomputed.

initiatives_funded.description: Distinct initiatives the donor has been shown (A-4).

events_volunteered.description: Events the donor checked in at.

account_role.description: The principal's role, fixed at account creation and immutable.

timezone.description: IANA zone derived from the ZIP; drives day-level streak state in the donor's own day.

push_referral_converted.description: App notification when someone the donor invited makes their first gift. Starts on: the device's notification permission is the opt-in.

push_streak_at_risk.description: App notification when a declined monthly payment puts the donor's giving streak at risk. Starts on.

push_streak_lapsed.description: App notification when the donor's giving streak has lapsed after the grace period on a failed monthly payment. Starts on.

push_streak_milestone.description: App notification when the donor's giving streak reaches an R1 day milestone. Starts on.

push_badge_earned.description: App notification when the donor earns a new badge. Starts on.

push_event_nearby.description: App notification when an event is published near a volunteer (E-1). Sent only while `volunteer` is on.

push_event_reminder.description: App notification 24 hours and 2 hours before an event the donor reserved.

push_event_promoted.description: App notification when the donor moves off an event waitlist.

rankings_opted_out.description: When true the donor is excluded from national/city rankings and from everyone's ranking denominator. Default off (ranked).

network_visible.description: When true the donor appears by name in their referrer's invitee list; otherwise they are counted anonymously (N-3). On by default: visibility is opt-out (§10).

volunteer.description: When true the donor is in the volunteer pool and receives event alerts (E-1). Default off.

volunteer_interests.description: Event interests the donor picked when opting in as a volunteer (E-1); empty when none chosen.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version; send it back when saving preferences.

push_gift_processed.description: App notification when a verified gift is processed. Starts on.

environment.description: The APNs environment for iOS; null for Android.

more.description: Whether older conversions after `since` were left out.

Conversion.description: A referral's first gift. It carries nothing about the referred donor.

link.description: Referral link, once a public name is chosen.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page, or null on the last page.

refunded_minor.description: Successfully refunded so far, in cents.

tax_receipt.description: Always false in R1: sandbox records are not tax receipts.

timezone.description: IANA zone that bounds the calendar year.

observed_at.description: When the subscription was last synced from Stripe; present with `subscription`.

id.description: Subscription attempt ID used by recurring commands.

oneOf.description: An update that finished before a new one could begin.

ceremony.description: Single-use ID to send back with the credential.

PasskeyInfo.description: A passkey the donor can sign in with. Credential material is never returned.

name.description: The donor's label for the passkey, if they gave one.

last_used_at.description: The last sign-in with this passkey; null if it has never signed in.

EventView.description: One event as a donor sees it (E-3).

spots_left.description: Spots remaining (capacity minus reserved), floored at 0; null when uncapped.

reservation_status.description: The signed-in donor's own status for this event; null on an anonymous read or no active reservation.

invitation_note.description: "Invitation earned at ..." for an INVITE_ONLY event unlocked by a badge perk (E-5); null otherwise.

report_issue_url.description: mailto link to report an issue about this event to DAD (E-10); null when no support email is configured.

cancelled.description: The event was cancelled; it can no longer be reserved and every place was released.

booking_opens_at.description: When reservations open to everyone; null when they opened at publication.

early_booking.description: True while the signed-in donor, a Team Captain, may reserve before booking opens to everyone (B-3). Always false on the public read.

type.description: The kind of work, e.g. PROGRAM.

CheckInResult.description: The outcome of a QR check-in (E-8).

ReservationResult.description: The outcome of a reserve or cancel (E-4).

next_milestone.description: Null once every referral tier is reached.

anonymous_active.description: Active referrals who did not opt in to being named; counted but not listed.

NetworkMilestone.description: The next referral tier the donor has not yet reached (N-2).

NetworkInvitee.description: One opted-in person the donor brought in (N-3).

name.description: First name + last initial, as the invitee chose to display it.

active.description: Whether the invitee is still giving.

rule.description: How the badge is earned, shown on an unearned badge (B-1).

started_on.description: When it started, or is planned to start when in the future

partner.description: The approved partner's name, or null when none is linked

Offset.description: Rows to skip. Pages hold up to 50 rows; pass the previous page's `next_offset` until it is null.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A fresh version 4 UUID per distinct command. Retrying with the same key and body returns the original outcome and never repeats the effect; the same key with a different body is a 409.
